name.full: Nonna — the trattoria's back office for Microsoft 365 Copilot

description.short: The back office: roster, absence requests, requisitions, invoices.
description.full: Nonna runs everything Giuseppe doesn't: the shift rota, the absences, the purchase orders and the invoice ledger of the Copilot Pizza Factory's trattoria. She lives entirely inside Microsoft 365 — ask about tonight's shifts, tell her someone called in sick, review the orders waiting for a signature, or check the books, and Copilot renders her desk as a living UI instead of a wall of text. Warm but strict; sees everything; never gossips. PREVIEW: built on SharePoint Framework 1.24 Copilot components.
